# Temml 0.14.0

Vendored unchanged from the npm `temml@0.14.0` distribution (https://temml.org/):
`dist/temml.mjs`, `dist/Temml-Local.css`, `dist/Temml.woff2`, and `LICENSE`.
MIT licensed; see LICENSE. Font provenance is noted at the top of Temml-Local.css.

The shared simulation renderer uses the public `render` API to create native,
accessible MathML, with untrusted commands disabled and expansion/size limits.
Assets are served locally: no CDN, frontend build step, or runtime npm install.
When upgrading, rerun the math and browser regression tests.
